# Scripts, buttons, running code, and the console

## RStudio and Positron

- R vs the IDE
  - R: language and interpreter
  - IDE: interface for writing, running, and inspecting code
- Panes
  - Source editor: write and save scripts
  - Console: send code to R and see results
  - Environment: view session objects
  - Files, plots, packages, help: supporting views
- Main controls
  - New, open, save script
  - Runing current line or a selection
  - Source entire script
  - Stopping running code
  - Restarting R

## Script versus console

- Script
  - Saved source of the analysis
  - Can be run in full or in part
  - Comments and section breaks
- Console
  - Immediate experiments
  - Included in history
- Dangers of the consule
  - Edit the environment but aren't documented
    - Can break reproducibility

## Running code

- Things that can be run
  - Line
  - Selection
  - Whole script
- Top-to-bottom execution
- Feedback from the code
  - Printed output
  - Messages and warnings
  - Errors

# Environment and why not to save it

## The environment as session state

- Named objects in memory
- Environment pane
  - Object inventory
  - Current values
- Session lifetime
  - Objects created when running old code
  - Objects removed when R restarts

## The hidden-state problem

- Stale objects from earlier work
- Objects created out of order
- Different results across machines or sessions

## Saved workspace versus reproducible analysis

- Saved workspace
  - Creates an `.RData`
- Objects reappear without rerunning code
- Costs
  - Hidden inputs
  - Unclear history of the object
- Preferred workflow
  - Write and edit code in a script
  - Save any necessary outputs explicitly
  - Once ready, run the script in a fresh environment

# Packages, libraries, and variables

## Packages: reusable code

- How we share code
  - All R code that you see in Base R is from packages
- What a package contains
  - Functions
  - Documentation (vignettes, examples)
  - Example data
- Installation
  - Once per R install-package version pair
  - e.g. `install.packages("readr")`
- "Base R" vs. "contributed packages"

## Libraries: packages in the current session

- Loading a package
  - Once per session
  - Example: `library(readr)`
- Explicit namespace
  - Example: `readr::read_csv()`
- Flag for the future
  - May see devtools::load_all(); this loads a local library

## Variables: named objects

- Object as a named value
- Assignment
  - Name gets value (`x <- 1`)
  - Inspecting the value by printing (`x`)
  - Reassignment by assigning after (`x <- 2`)
- Naming conventions
  - Descriptive names (don't use `x`)
  - `snake_case`
  - Case sensitivity
  - No spaces

## Working with variables

- Variables as a superset: anything can be variable
- Preview: types
  - `str(x)`
  - `class(x)`
- `length(x)` and `lengths(x)`
